tourInvite.title: Want a quick tour?
tourInvite.text: Six short steps: where your stats live, how to connect WakaTime and how to join the tournament. Under a minute.

nav.title: Navigation
nav.text: Every section lives here. The badge on Messages counts unread threads.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.text: Your main summary: time in code, languages and projects, and the hours when you are most productive.

integrations.title: Start here
integrations.text: Until WakaTime is connected the dashboard stays empty. It takes a minute — all you need is an API key.

leaderboard.title: Tournament
leaderboard.text: A seasonal table of members. A season is a time of year; counters reset when it ends, but results are kept in history.

messages.title: Messages
messages.text: Chat with other members and with support. On Pro, the AI agent posts a daily breakdown of your stats here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Profile, privacy, notifications and subscription. Theme and language live here too.
